nodes.label: Tomato Disease Detection Result Screen
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the tomato disease detection result screen from the Smart Plant Disease app. Shows AI/ML model output after analyzing a tomato leaf image. Disease detected: Tomato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) with high confidence (~94%). Features: back arrow navigation, detection result card, confidence progress bar, analyzed tomato leaf thumbnail showing dark brown/black lesions and water-soaked patches, disease description section, and treatment recommendations (remove infected parts, apply copper-based fungicide, improve air circulation, avoid overhead watering). Card-based scrollable layout with orange/red disease severity indicators.

nodes.label: Guide / Tutorial Screen (Panduan)
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the guide/tutorial (Panduan) screen from the Smart Plant Disease app. Features: green header bar with back arrow and 'Panduan' title in white bold text. White background main content area with numbered step-by-step tutorial instructions in Indonesian. Each step has a large green number badge, instructional text, and an accompanying illustration/screenshot. Steps teach users how to use the plant disease detection feature. Bottom navigation bar consistent with rest of app. Green and white color scheme.

nodes.label: Home / Plant Selection Screen (Beranda - Pilih Tanaman)
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the home/plant-selection screen for the Smart Plant Disease mobile app. Features: dark green gradient header with app title 'Smart Plant Disease' and subtitle 'Deteksi Penyakit Tanaman' (Plant Disease Detection) in white text. Main content is a 2-column grid of tappable plant selection cards. Each card shows a plant photograph and Indonesian name. Plants shown: Jagung (Corn), Padi (Rice), Kentang (Potato), Tomat (Tomato), Cabai (Chili Pepper), and possibly others. Bottom navigation bar with Beranda, Deteksi, Riwayat, Profil tabs. Material Design-inspired mobile UI with green and white color scheme.

nodes.label: Chili Plant Photo (Cabai)
nodes.description: Photograph of a chili pepper plant (Capsicum annuum / Capsicum frutescens). Leaves are ovate-lanceolate with alternate branching, consistent with Indonesian 'cabai'. Plant shows moderate-to-poor health: yellowing (chlorosis) on lower leaves, small dark spots/lesions possibly indicating Cercospora leaf spot, bacterial leaf spot, or anthracnose, and mild leaf curl suggesting possible mite/thrips infestation or viral infection.

nodes.label: Corn/Maize Plant Photo (Jagung)
nodes.description: Photograph of a corn/maize plant (Zea mays). Large broad strap-like leaves with parallel venation and prominent central midrib confirm maize identification. Plant shows moderate health with possible fungal disease symptoms: brownish spots and discoloration consistent with common rust, possible Northern Leaf Blight (elongated tan lesions), possible Gray Leaf Spot (rectangular vein-bounded patches), and tip/edge browning.

nodes.label: Potato Plant Photo (Kentang)
nodes.description: Photograph of a potato plant (Solanum tuberosum). Broadleaf agricultural crop from the Solanaceae family. Image shows poor-to-moderate plant health with visible yellowing (chlorosis), brown/dark spots or necrotic areas, and possible margin browning. Symptoms consistent with possible early blight (Alternaria solani), late blight (Phytophthora infestans), or nutrient deficiency.

nodes.label: Rice Plant Photo (Padi)
nodes.description: Photograph of a rice plant (Oryza sativa). Long narrow linear leaf blades with parallel venation confirm Poaceae/grass family identification consistent with rice (padi). Detailed disease assessment could not be fully confirmed from image but plant displays some yellowing/browning indicators. Rice blast, bacterial leaf blight, and brown spot are common diseases assessed for this crop.

nodes.label: Tomato Plant Photo (Tomat)
nodes.description: Photograph of a tomato plant (Solanum lycopersicum). Pinnately compound leaves with serrated/toothed leaflet margins and slightly pubescent surface confirm tomato identification. Plant shows moderate health in early warning stage: leaf edge browning, minor irregular spotting consistent with early fungal infection, slight leaf curl possibly from heat/water stress or early viral infection, and uneven green coloration suggesting nutrient stress.
